Why this boundary: the accepted chain (chunked stem trial-4bdb465d41-param-0bfb4c5a, then chunked stages.0/1 trial-31442e4c3a-param-9aa9f111; paired 281,975,808 -> 204,905,472 -> 155,229,184 B) has moved the allocator peak into two moments that cannot be reduced from the inner boundaries separately. Editing either bundle alone is capped by the other (~153.5 MB), and the encoder's parent loop (embedder call returns one full (32,64,56,56) tensor that then coexists with stage-0's full-size preallocated input and output) makes cross-stage streaming impossible while the embedder/stage boundaries stay installed: per the binding contract the fused rewrite must explicitly replace both affected whole bundles, and the smallest coherent boundary owning the whole pixels-to-encoder-output path is the ResNetModel forward call. stages.2/stages.3 are inside the region because their eager moments (during stages.2.layers.0: 66,025,632 + 12,845,056 input + up to 5x6,422,528 temporaries ~ 111-117 MB) would become the binding peak inside the predicted post-edit range if left eager, while streaming them adds only tiny chunk tensors ((8,128,28,28)=3,211,264; (8,256,14,14)=1,605,632; (8,512,7,7)=802,816). The classifier head (Flatten/Linear under the root call f2cf62caf57ad09f5d2f36aa) stays outside: its tensors are <= 65,536+128,000 B, so replacing it would add eliminated-call surface without moving peak_allocated_bytes. Profiler record_function marker groups are not selected: they are discovery instrumentation around captured ops, not computational work, and the framework's recapture emits fresh markers; their in-region calls (including the 25 in-region member calls of the mixed exit-marker group 798df708d05932b17f71, which also holds classifier-phase calls this proposal does not touch) are included in affected_calls as eliminated observations, exactly as the previous accepted region bundle treated them.
hypothesis: Replace the ResNetModel boundary with one fused streaming implementation: slice the frozen GPU-resident (32,3,224,224) fp32 input into fixed sample chunks (default 8, remainder loop for other batch sizes) and stream each chunk end-to-end through the identical parent aten chain executed via context.references - stem conv2d(7x7 s2) -> eval batch_norm (training=False, frozen running stats) -> relu -> max_pool2d; stages.0-3 conv2d/batch_norm/relu/add_/1x1-shortcut; adaptive_avg_pool2d - writing each chunk's result into one preallocated full-size sequence/pooler output, so no full (32,64,56,56) stem output and no full-size stage intermediate ever coexist. All these operators are strictly per-sample, so fixed-batch chunking is elementwise exact. Post-edit peak live set: weights 46,758,048 + pixels 19,267,584 + preallocated outputs ~3.4 MB ((32,512,7,7) sequence + (32,512,1,1) pooled) ~ 69.4 MB base, plus the single largest concurrent temporary set - the stem chain at (c,64,112,112)=25,690,112 B per tensor at c=8. Keeping the installed out-of-place chain at stem chunk 8 (~2.4 concurrent temporaries per the 153,525,248 B stem moment) yields ~131 MB; halving the stem chunk to 4 ((4,64,112,112)=12,845,056 each, ~30.8 MB) or running the batch_norm affine/relu chain in place on the conv output (25,690,112 + 6,422,528 pool input) yields ~95-107 MB. Expected peak_allocated_bytes ~95-125 MB versus the accepted 155,229,184 (-20% to -39%; -56% to -66% versus the original 281,975,808), with a hard floor ~76 MB (weights+pixels+outputs+one >=6.4 MB chunk temporary) - to be measured by the paired evaluator. Throughput floor images_per_second >= 7120.308 (latency <= 4.4942 ms): the accepted chunk-8 endpoints measured 7,569-8,336 ips leaving ~0.27-0.46 ms headroom; stage-side batch-8 conv cost is measured +18% while BN/relu run ~3x faster; the chunk-4 throughput failure (5,418.94 ips) came from 30 stage sites x 8 chunks of small convs, not from the single large 7x7 stem conv, and final-output D2D copies shrink from 38.5 MB to ~3.2 MB; a declared parameter space (stem chunk {4,8}, tail chunk {8,16}, optional eager-parent fallback for stages.2/3 inside the same boundary) lets the frozen search pick the memory/throughput point. Quality risks left to measurement: cudnn algorithm re-keying at chunked shapes and in-place BN decomposition rounding, both ~1e-6 relative against the 1e-4 logits tolerance (prior accepted chunks measured max_abs_error 7.6e-6 with exact top-1 and the +1-corruption control rejected); the frozen evaluator's repeated-forward closeness, exact-top1 and negative-control checks in observe() verify this on every invocation, and per-chunk reference execution keeps every inherited required aten site running and counted.
